title: Move the Python packages under src
summary: Move locomotion, navigation, mission and contracts under src/ and install them in editable mode through uv_build, so imports resolve from any directory and the checkout no longer doubles as the import root. robot/, tools/, tests/, configs/, docs/ and site/ stay at the root as data, tooling and publication. Native packs keep their flat layout, so src/ mirrors a pack's /source root and every recorded identity key keeps its string. Pushed records that cite moved files resolve through archived sources at the previous branch head.
next: Push the branch so CI runs on the exact revision, then run native standing admission and the 13-probe parity of c48_long on Spark.
reason: The layout changes no robot, training code path, gate or recorded result; native admission stays pending.
